theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_tc_truncate_at_good_radius
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : IMRep U (m + 1)) (ρ s : ℝ), IsOpen U → R.Represents S → (∀ β : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 s → S.boundary β = 0) → 0 < ρ → ρ < s → ball (0 : Euclid P) s ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), A ω = ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂R.measure) → A.boundary.massOn (ball 0 s) ≠ ∞ → ∃ (Ŝ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R'.Represents Ŝ ∧ R'.measure = R.measure.restrict (ball 0 ρ) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ ω = currentEval S (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) ∧ (∀ β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 ρ → Ŝ.boundary β = 0) ∧ Ŝ.boundary.massOn univ ≤ A.boundary.massOn (ball 0 s)
